events.title: HF Analytics and Parsed Logs
events.description: Omniscient parsed Apache logs and used ChatGPT to package the stats for advertisers — the resulting thread is the go-to reference for anyone considering advertising on HF.

events.title: DMCA Notices Fighting Back
events.description: Omniscient pushed back on the steady stream of false DMCA notices, which have been hurting the site's SEO and search visibility for years.

events.title: Convo App - Dev Blog #1
events.description: MarlboroMan released a fully native desktop Convo client built with Tauri, Rust, TypeScript, and React for Windows, Linux, and macOS — a major upgrade over the base web Convo, and a community-built project from a developer learning Rust.

events.title: Awards
events.description: King Decade awarded to Bagon, WuTangClan, Wolf., and DexterGO. Blazing Ember awarded to JoseMar (winner of the Quantum New Year contest).

events.title: Group & Crew News
events.description: Casino was listed for sale by NERO. Succubus, Olympians/Benevolence, and Mystery Inc remain listed for sale.

events.title: 100,000 Bytes Contest - $250 Value
events.description: Moooookie is hosting a Bytes giveaway open to L33t-or-higher members, ending February 14.

events.title: Secrets Member Upgrades
events.description: Secrets is running a free-upgrade giveaway for users who post and have been on site over a month — already several upgrades have been awarded.

events.title: Convo App 1.0.0 - HackForums Convo Desktop App
events.description: MarlboroMan released the 1.0.0 desktop Convo app — built with Tauri, Rust, TypeScript, and React — featuring native notifications, thread viewers, profile cards, embeds, themes, and drag-and-drop uploads on Windows, Linux, and macOS.

events.title: [Legends] Fully Automated TikTok System
events.description: JoseMar (winner of the Quantum Group New Year's Contest) released a fully automated Python + FFmpeg system that converts long-form video into hundreds of TikToks, Reels, and Shorts — with batch processing, GUI downloaders, error handling, and detailed reporting.

events.title: What Keyboard do you use?
events.description: RangoWorld kicked off a discussion on keyboard preferences — mechanical vs membrane, RGB vs minimal, comfort vs aesthetics — with members weighing in on what works for writing, coding, and long-form work.

events.title: [Legends] Enterprise Probabilistic Graph Analysis Engine
events.description: Dystortion shared a deep dive into the architecture of a production probabilistic inference engine — covering ZINB models, HMMs, change-point detection, and correlation-aware fusion for noisy, time-dependent data.

events.title: Movie of the Week — Home Alone & Home Alone 2
events.description: DemonAsylum submitted Home Alone & Home Alone 2 in honour of Catherine O'Hara, who recently passed away.
